verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's docs list official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET. They describe the SDKs as offering type-hinted methods and abstractions that automate request signing for Payments POST requests, and a public GitHub repo provides companion signing libraries. missing for 10: per-SDK reference or installation documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs themselves (the GitHub evidence covers only the signing libraries).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET.

They simplify API calls with easy-to-use interfaces, type-hinted methods and abstractions. They also automate request signing for all Payments POST requests, reducing the need for manual configuration.
Convenient libraries to produce TrueLayer API requests signatures.
